videos.desc: A huge golden wheat field on flat plains at sunset, under orange and purple clouds. Three large green combine harvesters move across the field in a line, cutting the wheat and throwing up clouds of dust. The nearest one pours a steady stream of grain from its long arm into a trailer pulled by a green tractor driving alongside. Uncut wheat fills the foreground, and a row of metal grain silos stands on the far horizon.

On tall orange sand dunes under a clear blue sky, a young woman in a white crop top, a flowing rust-coloured skirt and a mustard scarf leaps barefoot down the steep slope in one huge stride, arms flung up and laughing, with sand spraying from her foot. She lands and keeps bounding down towards the camera in big strides, sand flying, and runs past. Lower down two people with backpacks walk across the slope, and a line of camels rests at the foot of the dune.

Seen straight down from above, grey tidal mudflats lie at low tide. A shining channel of water runs down from the top and splits again and again into smaller and smaller forks, like the trunk and branches of a tree, and the water glitters as it flows. The small dark shadow of a plane slowly crosses the mud, a line of old wooden posts runs diagonally across the lower part, and a small white rowing boat lies stranded near the bottom. Green strands of seaweed catch along the channels.

From the top of wooden beach steps, two hands in a knitted cardigan hold up an old printed picture of a sunny sandy beach with a small blue hut on stilts and people on the sand. Behind it the same coast now looks completely different: the sand is gone, grey waves smash against black rocks, and a broken hut lies on the rocks. A man and a woman in a yellow raincoat lean on a hut balcony and look down. Then one hand lowers the picture and holds up a steaming mug under a stormy evening sky.

A narrow stone water channel runs straight through an olive grove in warm evening light. On the left a wooden sluice gate on a metal post stands open, and brown water gushes through the opening, foaming and swirling along the channel between the two stone walls and carrying dry leaves with it. The water spreads and rises over the channel floor. A small wooden footbridge crosses the channel further along, dust hangs in the low sun and the ground in front is dry and cracked.

On a sandy beach at sunset under heavy clouds, a young man in a peach running jacket, black leggings and trainers runs along the sand with a phone to his ear, then stops short in surprise with his mouth open in front of the huge black wooden ribs of an old shipwreck sticking out of the sand, hung with orange seaweed and dripping with water. A shaggy grey dog barks at the wreck beside him. Far behind, a couple walk along the shore and a lighthouse stands on a headland.

A mountain stream flows over smooth grey rock. In the foreground the water has worn a deep round hollow into the rock, like a big stone bowl, filled with clear green water. A small trout swims slowly around inside, and a rounded stone rests on its bottom. Water from the waterfall behind splashes in, making rings that spread across the surface and then calm. A fallen log leans against the falls, and moss, pine needles and smaller hollows lie below.

In a wheat field at golden hour, a young woman with wavy auburn hair in a long ivory satin dress runs barefoot straight through the tall ripe wheat towards the camera, laughing, pushing white sunglasses up onto her head and carrying a pair of white high heels in one hand. Pigeons fly up beside her. Far back, a group of wedding guests waits by a gate near a red tractor, and a stone church tower rises behind the trees.

Hilly countryside at sunrise. A deep, wide hollow in the green hills is filled with white mist that slowly drifts and swells, with a waterfall pouring over its rim at the far end and a line of cows standing along the top of the ridge against the orange sky. Treetops poke out of the fog and a flock of birds flies across it. Below, a stone farmhouse with a smoking chimney sits by a winding lane, a dry stone wall with fence posts runs down the slope, and two hares sit in the grass beside a gnarled tree.

On a bright salt flat, a young woman's boots step exactly along the sharp line where the white salt crust meets dark gravel, and dust rises by her feet. The view pulls back: she wears a wide-brimmed hat, mirrored sunglasses, a khaki shirt and trousers, and walks towards the camera with her arms stretched out for balance, wobbling a little. Behind her two men stand by canvas tents, a folding table and an off-road car, and pink flamingos wade far away on the left.

On a wet mossy rock in front of a tall waterfall in a green mountain valley, a young woman in a black swimsuit stands barefoot with her arms spread wide, head tilted back and mouth open in a shout of joy as the spray soaks her hair and skin. For a moment she puts a hand over her face and laughs, then spreads her arms again. The white column of water pours down behind her, and steep forested slopes lie on both sides under a pale sky.

At the edge of a huge waterfall in a rocky canyon, wide curtains of white water pour over a cliff into a deep gorge, throwing up clouds of spray with a rainbow in it. On the wet rock in front, a young man in a black tailcoat plays a shiny black grand piano with his coat tails flapping and spray blowing over him. Tourists in colourful rain ponchos stand behind a railing, and two people shelter under an umbrella.

In green hill country on a sunny day, a pale green off-road vehicle drives straight through a shallow stony river towards the viewer, throwing up big splashes, while a smiling young man leans out of a side window. Beside it a line of flat stepping stones runs across the river, where sheep stand waiting, and an older walker stands on the dirt track on the far bank. A wooden marker post stands in the water and a green rubber boot lies on the stones.

A narrow green valley lies deep between steep, misty mountains with waterfalls running down their sides. A double rainbow arches across the valley under grey clouds while a bird of prey flies above. A line of shaggy brown long-horned cattle walks along a dirt path beside a clear rocky stream, and some of them splash through the water. Purple heather and ferns grow along the stream, and a roofless stone cottage, a lone tree, a stone wall and a stag on a hill stand nearby.

A young woman with long dark hair in a black wetsuit and long black fins swims in deep blue sea beneath a huge floating block of ice. She kicks her fins and glides along under the ice, then turns upwards and stretches one arm towards the ice above, with a trail of silver bubbles rising behind her. Beams of sunlight shine down through the water from around the edge of the ice, and the water below her fades into dark blue.

A big clump of dark brown earth breaks off a steep bank of soil at the edge of a freshly ploughed field and falls in a cloud of dust, showing roots and pale chalky layers. The earth crashes down and the dust slowly settles, while a badger peeks out of a burrow in the bank. A red fox stands on the loose ground at the top and looks down, crows walk on the furrows behind it in the morning mist, and at the bottom a rusty plough blade lies in a muddy brown puddle among broken branches and stones.

On a rocky hilltop high above the sea, a man in a red jacket, black helmet and sunglasses runs off the rock as an orange paraglider wing fills above him. He lifts into the air and floats away over a turquoise gulf of calm water, almost closed in by green hilly headlands with white houses, while the open sea shines in the sun beyond. Two people stand near a striped windsock on the slope below and watch him as he flies further out and gets smaller.

At the rim of a huge fresh crater in a flat desert under a grey sky, a young woman with curly hair tied back, in a rust-coloured jacket and beige trousers, stands on a cracked slab and looks down into it. She crouches, picks up a small grey rock fragment and turns it in her fingers, smiling. Below her the ground is torn open in layers of red, grey and white rock, broken boulders lie across the slopes and smoke still rises from the centre of the crater.

A shallow coral reef in clear blue water. A young diver in a black and blue wetsuit, mask and air tank swims low over the reef and reaches towards the coral, with bubbles rising above her. Most of the coral around her has died and turned bone white: large branching white corals and pale round corals, with only a few patches of brown coral left. A yellow measuring tape and a white slate lie across the reef, and one small orange fish swims among the white branches. The diver turns her head and looks straight ahead with wide eyes.

From a high rocky headland with pink sea flowers, the view looks over a northern bay at golden hour. A long line of brown horses splashes through the calm shallow water towards a sandy beach on the wide green mainland, the first horse reaching the sand at the end. Across the bay lie a pine forest and a small village at the foot of distant mountains, and small boats dot the glowing water under a low sun. A seal rests on the rocks below.

In a flat, wet marsh at sunset, a young woman in a black long-sleeved wetsuit kneels on a paddle board and paddles along a narrow channel of still water between tall green and golden grasses, right through a flock of pink flamingos that wade and take off around her. More flamingos fly across the pink sky. A white horse grazes in the grassland, a wooden bird-watching tower stands on the horizon and the board is reflected in the water.

A frozen lake at dusk in winter. A young woman in a red parka and red snow trousers kneels on the dark clear ice and screams with laughter as a flame from a small hole in the ice grows into a tall orange column of fire. White frozen gas bubbles are trapped in stacks inside the ice all around. Behind her two people in dark winter coats take photos, and a metal gas cylinder, a snowmobile and small wooden cabins stand along the snowy shore by the trees.

The sea between two towering dark cliffs. A young woman in a white helmet and navy jacket paddles a bright red kayak through the narrow gap between the rock walls and comes out towards the camera, smiling with excitement as white water foams around her. Grey seals lie on the rocks on both sides and watch her. Behind her another kayaker in yellow waits in the open water, and a lighthouse stands on a far headland in the hazy backlight.

In front of a huge blue-white glacier wall. A woman with a knitted headband, a red jacket, leather work gloves and a climbing harness lifts a large chunk of clear blue ice broken off from the glacier up in front of her face, turns it, then lowers it to her chest and looks at the camera. The block is full of tiny air bubbles and drips water. Her breath steams in the cold air, and small floating pieces of ice and a black gravel shore lie behind her in bright sunlight.

A wooden workbench in a rock shop. The viewer's hands in a red checked shirt hold a plain grey round stone that cracks into two halves, with grit falling down, and open it to show that it is full of sparkling purple crystals inside. A young woman in a turquoise jumper with long braids leans on the bench, smiles widely and points at the crystals. A chain cutter, a green lamp, a sack of uncut round stones and shelves of crystals are around, and red desert rocks show through the window.

A snowy volcano at dusk with no people. A thick stream of glowing orange lava pours from the top of the slope and runs down the mountainside in a wide river, spilling over rocks in a bright cascade and cutting through the white snow. Hot pieces of rock fly through the air at first, the lava keeps gushing and splashing as it falls, and the crater glows red at the summit. Bare birch trees and a small pool stand in the snow beside the flow, and black lava rocks fill the foreground.

A view from a small stone platform with a railing and an old green lamp post, looking down a wide river in a town on a sunny autumn day. Two rivers come together here and flow side by side: on the left the water is clear turquoise, on the right it is cloudy grey-brown, with a sharp line where the two touch. A white swan swims into view on the turquoise side and a small boat drifts in on the right. Stone embankments, yellow trees, old houses, a footbridge and snowy mountains are behind.

A small rusty metal bus shelter with a single seat stands alone on a huge flat white salt plain that stretches away in every direction. There is no road, no bus, no building and no person anywhere, only cracked white ground, a shallow puddle reflecting the sky and a thin metal pole. Wind swirls dust across the plain and lifts a loose metal sheet on the shelter's roof, which flaps up and bangs down again. Dark mountains lie far off under heavy grey-blue clouds. The mood is lonely.

A forest trail in autumn, with golden leaves on the trees and brown ferns and fallen leaves on the ground. A young woman in a bike helmet, green top and orange vest rides a blue mountain bike down the dirt path. A large red deer stag with big antlers suddenly leaps out of the ferns right in front of her and across the path, and she brakes hard, skidding to a stop as the deer disappears. She stands over her bike, staring with her mouth open in shock, then smiles in relief.

A sandy beach at sunset. A detailed sandcastle with towers and a little flag stands at the edge of the sea, covered by a big clear glass dome. A wave crashes against the dome and sprays white foam, then washes around it, but the sandcastle inside stays dry and whole. A laughing young woman in a white shirt kneels in the surf holding the dome, a young man in blue shorts kneels on the other side holding it too, and a woman in a yellow top and denim shorts throws her arms up and cheers behind them.
